newsitem.title: USA: Brady debt slips, spreads over US Treasuries widen.
newsitem.headline: Brady debt slips, spreads over US Treasuries widen.

text.p: Emerging markets debt prices turned mostly lower on Wednesday, particularly those of Latin American issues, traders said.
Spreads over U.S. Treasuries widened overall, with Russia and Bulgaria as notable exceptions, they said.
"Pretty much all the Latins widened," one trader said. "Venezuela widened out about 50 basis points, Argentina maybe 10 to 15 basis points and Mexico maybe five to 10 basis points."
Argentine Bradys got a boost earlier in the day after Standard & Poor's announced it would review the country's BB sovereign rating, traders and analysts said.
